name: JMB VL-3 Evolution
summary: Czech composite two-seat light-sport aircraft with a short, slender wing and very clean lines.

wings: Low cantilever wing with no struts
engines: Single Rotax 912 in a small, smooth cowl
fuselage: Slim composite fuselage with a snug bubble canopy
Fixed or retractable tricycle gear, usually with streamlined fairings
tail: Small, clean tail surfaces on a slender tail cone

tellTales: Tiny glossy composite two-seat low-wing with a snug bubble canopy
Short, slender wing and streamlined faired gear
Small Rotax cowl on a very clean airframe

confusedWith.howToTell: The DA20 has a T-tail and a bigger, more rounded cabin; the VL-3 is smaller with a short-span wing.
The XL-2 is larger with a rectangular wing and a big windscreen; the VL-3 is tiny with a short, slender wing.
The Alarus is a plainer all-metal two-seater with a blunt nose; the VL-3 is a slicker composite airframe.
